Climate Sandbox

Paint land onto the present-day or 21 ka world, choose a year (or set CO₂ and global temperature yourself), then press Visualize! to see the predicted temperature and climate.

1 · Draw land

Base map
Altitude above 0 m becomes land, 0 m or below becomes water. Painting land over water (or water over land) removes the ice on those pixels. A white tint on the map = ice (thicker ice = whiter). In Ice thickness mode the brush paints ice of the chosen thickness without changing altitude or land; set it to 0 m to remove ice.
Hover the map to read a pixel.
